IC1: Male [OR] or female = 2 years of age;
IC2: Have sickle cell disease (confirmed by Hb electrophoresis [OR] or more specific tests) [OR] or other conditions with iron overload [AND] from repeated blood transfusions (see exclusion criteria for exceptions);
IC3: Baseline LIC  >7 mg/g dw [AND] (measured by MRI);
IC4: Patients who have received no less than 20 transfusions of RBCs;
IC5: Patients who have received at least 1 transfusion per year in the last 2 years and who are expected to have a continuing requirement (based on Investigator's judgement) during the duration of the trial
